t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Essentially, there are two groups of gnomes the pink and yellow and the blue and green. One of the groups will give better mushroom then the other which you should figure out early and pick as much as possible. But at some point this group will start giving out less points and at that point you should switch to the other group.

vb_textbox.text: To help you succeed in the game, it's essential to understand the colour themes and the points system. Here’s a detailed guide, There are two main groups of colors. Group 1: Purple and Pink and Group 2: Blue and Yellow. Additionally, there are two other colors: Brown and Green. These might play a role in your strategy depending on the game's mechanics.Points System: At different times during the game, one group will give you more points than the other. Sometimes, Group 1 (Purple and Pink) will yield the highest points.Other times, Group 2 (Blue and Yellow) will be more rewarding. Strategy for Maximizing Points: Keep a close eye on which group is currently giving the highest points. This can change as you continue to play. When you notice that the points from the currently favored group (whether it's Group 1 or Group 2) start to decrease move to the other color group. For instance, if you’ve been focusing on Purple and Pink and their points start to drop, switch to focusing on Blue and Yellow.Repeat this process of switching between the groups whenever you observe a decline in points. This strategy ensures you are always optimizing your gameplay for the highest possible score.By following this approach, you'll be able to adapt quickly to changes in the game's scoring system and consistently maximize your points. Keep playing, stay observant, and switch groups strategically to stay ahead in the game!
